Progress is stored locally in SQLite.

lesson.L1-01.title: Home row: left hand
lesson.L1-01.intro: Rest your left fingers on ش س ی ب (keys A S D F): pinky ش, ring س, middle ی, index ب. Look at the text, not the keyboard.
lesson.L1-02.title: Home row: right hand
lesson.L1-02.intro: Rest your right fingers on ت ن م ک (keys J K L ;): index ت, middle ن, ring م, pinky ک.
lesson.L1-03.title: Home row complete
lesson.L1-03.intro: Add ل and ا with your index fingers (G and H) and گ with the right pinky (').
lesson.L1-04.title: Top row: left side
lesson.L1-04.intro: Reach up from the home row: ض ص ث ق ف. Return your fingers to the home row after every key.
lesson.L1-05.title: Top row: right side
lesson.L1-05.intro: Reach up with the right hand: غ ع ه خ ح ج چ پ.
lesson.L1-06.title: Bottom row
lesson.L1-06.intro: Reach down: ظ ط ز ر ذ د ئ و. Use the same finger that rests above each key.
lesson.L1-07.title: All letters
lesson.L1-07.intro: Mix every letter. Aim for accuracy first, speed will follow.
lesson.L3-01.title: Number row
lesson.L3-01.intro: Persian digits sit on the number row (1-0). Keep your hands anchored to the home row.
lesson.L3-05.title: Paragraph typing
lesson.L3-05.intro: Type the whole paragraph. Keep a steady rhythm.
